_notes.display: Small-caps line across the top of every lecture's title card. Use literal characters (·, —), not HTML entities: the converter escapes this string.
_notes.short: Left-hand label in the persistent footer bar on every slide. The same string as `display` is fine; shorten it if the footer looks crowded on a projector.
_notes.ed_course_id: Ed course number from the lessons URL: edstem.org/us/courses/<THIS>/lessons. Recorded in each notebook's `dma` metadata block so a future reader can trace a deck back to its source lesson.
_notes.ed_module: Name of the Ed module the lectures live in, as shown in Ed's sidebar. Used by the scrape script to pick the right module_id; not read by the converter.
